title: Stale doc-comments still describe the removed O(N) trial-verify key selection
description: After jfln replaced trial-verify with SIID-indexed lookup, these comments are now inaccurate: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/lichen_l2_rx.c:162-175 ('iterates through all registered peers... one peer's pubkey verifies'), lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lichen_l2_core.c:221 ('constant-time' claim about the old loop), lichen/subsys/lichen/link/include/lichen/replay.h:136. Update to describe SIID-indexed single-verify selection.
